title: DAY 33/90
REASONING
scenes.sub: Easy marks, if your logic is sharp
scenes.voice: Day thirty three of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, seventy three days to go. Today we train the brain: analytical reasoning, the quickest marks in General Aptitude.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Subject, general aptitude. Topic, analytical reasoning. These questions need no formulas, only careful reading and clean logic.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover logical deduction, inductive reasoning and number patterns, statements and conclusions, and data sufficiency questions.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
lines: All A are B ≠ All B are A
scenes.voice: Quick tip. All A are B does not mean all B are A. For some and none statements, draw a quick Venn diagram. In data sufficiency, test each statement alone before combining them.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Practice PDF is on Telegram now. Test from seven to nine P. M.: take it through the link in our Telegram channel, or simply visit our website, on mobile or laptop.

scenes.title: Day 32 Toppers
scenes.voice: Viscous flow toppers! Sweta Rani Sahoo takes rank one with a brilliant twenty nine out of thirty. Shivam Sahu is rank two, and Marndi rank three. Congratulations!
